# sce_forge_runtime_c — header-only algorithm and HAL library for code
# generated by SCE Forge's C11 backend.
#
# Policy: see SCE_FORGE.md §2.1 and RFC §synth-5-J-2 F1
#   - Static linking only; freestanding-mode-safe libc headers only
#     (stdint, stdbool, stddef, string)
#   - No stateful global services (no heap, no threads, no I/O)
#   - Header-only INTERFACE library (mirrors sce-forge-runtime/cpp shape)
#
# The include/ tree carries the codec / procedure / link / bytes /
# limits runtime headers consumed by generated C11 forge code; pure
# inline kinds (e.g. Transform) need no runtime header. Downstream
# consumers (e.g. watching-zenoh's MCU half) import this stable
# target.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

add_library(sce_forge_runtime_c INTERFACE)
add_library(SCE::forge_runtime_c ALIAS sce_forge_runtime_c)

target_include_directories(sce_forge_runtime_c INTERFACE
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

target_compile_features(sce_forge_runtime_c INTERFACE c_std_11)
